title: Growth Tech Lead
motivazione: Il ruolo richiede esperienza consolidata in product management tech, AI e leadership di team di ingegneri; il candidato ha forte background in growth, digital sales e gestione di team, ma manca di esperienza diretta in sviluppo software e AI, che è il requisito principale. Il gap più rilevante è la mancanza di competenze tecniche di ingegneria e AI.
testo_completo: Milan, Italy Hybrid Growth Tech Lead About us Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn’t stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives. By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need. What you’ll be doing As our Growth Tech Lead, you’ll be the person who turns technology, AI and data into Satispay’s next growth engine. You’ll lead a team of growth engineers and growth managers, own the roadmap of what we build, and scale the channels and products that will drive the next chapter of our growth. Referral loops, promotion systems, web apps and AI tools for growth: you’ll own them the way a product owner owns a product. That means defining the problem, prioritising the backlog, running structured experiments and shipping to scale, from first prototype to winning feature. Here’s what your day-to-day will look like: Incubate the next growth features - Turn raw ideas into experiments and minimum viable products (MVPs) that can become new growth features for Satispay or, just as valuable, a clear learning. Be our tech and AI voice in Marketing & Growth - Be the go-to person for how technology and AI can change the way we acquire, activate and retain users. Lead and grow your team - Manage and develop a team of 4 (for now!) made up of AI engineers and growth managers, setting a high bar and creating the space for them to own real problems. Own the roadmap and the sprints - Define priorities, run planning and delivery for the team, and make sure what we ship moves real business metrics. Own and scale referral loops - Take ownership of member-get-member, our referral programme and biggest marketing channel, and design, test and scale referral mechanics for each new Satispay product. Build and ship data products - Take projects from quick AI-built prototype to production, from web apps to growth products that can become part of the Satispay product suite, working closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations and Data. Grow Satispay organically - Own our website and landing pages with one goal: organically growing the Satispay user base. That means search strategy, content and technical performance, and a constant cycle of experimentation and conversion optimisation. Who we’re looking for We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you’re curious and ready for real ownership, you’ll fit in! Does this sound like you? Proven experience - 6+ years of experience in marketing/growth, tech product management and/or software engineering. Technical credibility - You’ve shipped production-grade products and can hold a real conversation with engineers about architecture, trade-offs and quality. Applied AI & automation mindset - You follow what’s happening in AI and know how to turn it into business-ready solutions that solve concrete problems. Growth & referral expertise - You understand funnels, experimentation and conversion optimisation, and ideally you’ve built or scaled referral or viral loops. Product mindset & Project Management - You’re comfortable owning a roadmap, prioritising ruthlessly, and taking ideas from 0→1. Cross-functional influence - You build trust and alignment with Product, Marketing, Sales and Data, even without formal authority. Impact-driven attitude - You’re driven by projects that move real metrics and you’re at ease navigating ambiguity. CareAbout: how we support your impact We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health (Private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops) 💰 Financial resources (Stock Option Plan, Meal vouchers, Relocation support if you’re moving countries) ⚙️ Growth and development (Professional development programs, Internal mobility, Language courses with Preply) 🌱 Flexibility (Unlimited PTO, Hybrid working policy*, Flexible working hours) 👨‍👩‍👧 Family (Enhanced parental leave, Additional leave for child sickness) *We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time. At Opella, we’re challenging how self-care works for millions of people and need leaders and experts ready to shape what’s next. As our Performance Marketing Lead , you’ll bring your eCommerce media expertise, analytical mindset and drive to accelerate growth and make health simpler, smarter and more human. About The Job As Performance Marketing Lead, you will shape and manage our eRetail media strategy for the Italian eCommerce market, with a strong focus on Amazon Advertising. You will drive profitable growth through performance-led media, including on-site paid search, programmatic display and video campaigns tailored to eCommerce platforms. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, National Media, Finance and our in-house eCommerce media buying Centre of Excellence, you will connect local business priorities with our global eCommerce strategy. Your insights will help our brands make better investment decisions, optimise campaign performance and turn eRetail media into a sustainable growth driver. Main Responsibilities Define and implement a cross-platform eRetail media strategy aligned with our eCommerce priorities, including sales growth, profitability, product prioritisation and brand objectives. Lead paid search, programmatic display and video campaigns across eRetail platforms, with a strong focus on Amazon Advertising. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance and National Media teams to align media investment, brand messaging and commercial priorities. Act as the strategic link between the Italian business, global eCommerce teams and our in-house media buying Centre of Excellence. Monitor campaign performance against agreed KPIs, translate results into actionable recommendations and reallocate budgets towards the strongest-performing opportunities. Communicate performance, investment priorities and budget recommendations clearly to brand teams and senior leadership. Build strong partnerships with eRetailers and technology providers, identifying new features, tools and media innovations that can improve performance. Stay ahead of eCommerce, retail media and digital marketing developments to continuously improve our capabilities and ways of working. About You Strong experience managing eRetail media campaigns, particularly within Amazon Advertising and other major eCommerce platforms. A proven track record of using performance marketing to drive online sales, revenue growth and return on media investment. Solid knowledge of paid search, pay-per-click advertising, programmatic display and video within eCommerce ecosystems. Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to interpret campaign and commercial data and turn performance metrics into clear actions. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to influence cross-functional and senior partners. Experience working with media agencies, in-house media buying teams, eRetailers or advertising technology providers. Fluent English and Italian, with the ability to work effectively in an international environment. This is more than the next step in your career, it’s a chance to lead change and help reinvent self-care for the world. If you’re ready to challenge, inspire and deliver impact that matters, we’re ready for you. We are challengers. We are Opella. About Us Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the global Over-the-Counter and Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements market. Our mission is to bring health into people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for half a billion consumers worldwide, and counting. At the heart of this mission are 100 loved brands, an 11,000-strong global team, 13 manufacturing sites and four specialised science and innovation development centres. Headquartered in France, Opella is the maker of brands including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and a healthier planet. Find out more at www.opella.com. The moment Fraud operations in banking are breaking. Volumes outpace hiring, attackers adopted AI first, and every Tier-1 board wants agentic AI with nothing production-grade to buy. Cleafy built the foundation, and it already runs inside some of Europe's largest banks. We know of no one else who has it. Our Digital Narrative turns raw session telemetry into a typed, causal record of what happened. It runs in production today, for tens of millions of users. On top of it we are building Nyx: autonomous, multi-agent fraud operations in real time, with every decision explainable to a regulator. That is the hard part, and it is why this role exists now rather than after launch. We are looking for the person who closes it. What You Will Own Name and own the category. Define agentic fraud operations for regulated enterprises: the language, the frame, the maturity model. Success is competitors positioning against it and analysts using our vocabulary. With the CEO at first, on your own after two quarters. Move the buyer up two floors. Rebuild the narrative for executives who redesign operating models and own the budget: value case, board framing, the deck a CIO forwards unedited. Make deep tech feel inevitable. Make the Digital Narrative clear to an executive in ninety seconds and rigorous enough for our research team. Storytelling built on the technology, not around it. Own product marketing end to end. Positioning, ICP, messaging, launches, pricing narrative, competitive and enablement. We sell demo-first, so you author the story with the CPO, as a peer. Build the credibility system. Advisory board, analysts on both sides of the Atlantic, press, threat research reporters want, partner co-marketing — so customers conclude we understand the threat better than their own team. Build the team behind you. A small team today and two funded hires to define. Requirements Who you are Bold by default, disciplined by method. You do not study a market in order to fit into it. You study it in order to break it precisely, at scale, and with a plan that survives contact with a Tier-1 procurement process. Detail is not the opposite of ambition here; it is what makes ambition credible. You have: 12+ years in B2B marketing, including time as the senior-most marketing leader in enterprise software or cybersecurity, or as the deputy who ran the function while someone else held the title You have run the whole function, not a slice, and built at least part of the team yourself You have marketed to regulated enterprises: ideally banks in EMEA. Payments, insurance and critical infrastructure count too You write, personally and well, in English. Your application includes one piece that changed what a market believed You use AI every day, not just in your slides. Not someone who "follows the AI topic": someone who has already broken a few workflows to build better ones. You have tried ten tools, thrown out eight, and kept the two that changed how your team works. Before you hire or open a new budget line, you ask: "what if an agent did this?" Even better if: You created a category, or were in the room when one was: a market that did not exist, given a name that stuck. Not a repositioning You can discuss an attack chain with our research team, read an architecture diagram, and argue about what an agent should be trusted to do alone You have built a US-scale voice from outside the US, or know exactly why that is hard You are comfortable being visible: stage, podcast, analyst call, journalist on deadline The mindset that matters to us Builder. Build first, refine after Real curiosity the kind that makes you take things apart to understand how they work Hands on. Willing to get your hands dirty This is not the right role for you if you need an established category to market inside, if your track record is demand generation optimisation, if you brief agencies rather than write, if you need consensus before taking a position publicly, or if AI lives in your slides rather than in your daily workflow. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Description Travel Requirement: This role requires frequent national travel within Italy, approximately 50% of working time. You will spend significant time in the field visiting partner and carrier locations across the Italian network — observing the live customer returns experience, coaching partner teams on the spot, and gathering the insights that shape how network-wide improvements are rolled out. All travel expenses are reimbursed in accordance with Amazon's travel and reimbursement policy. Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) exists to make returns effortless and reliable for every Amazon customer — no matter which store or partner they walk into. In Italy, we deliver that experience across more than 17,000 partner and carrier locations, through convenience-led options such as Label-Free, Box-Free (LFBF) drop-off and every other way a customer can return an item in-store. The ISX Program Manager, Italy owns the quality and consistency of that experience across the whole Italian network. Because returns run through thousands of independent partner sites, the experience can vary widely from one location to the next and the core of this role is closing that gap. You will get into the field, see how returns actually happen at partner locations, coach partners and their teams to the standard customers expect, and use data to focus your time on the sites that need help most. Your mission is holistic: improving in-store returns execution across all return types, so a customer's experience is just as good at the busiest location as it is at the smallest. This is not only a field-execution role. It carries a strategic remit that reflects its level. Beyond coaching individual sites, you will help design and deploy the network-wide improvements that lift the entire Italian network at once: in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment mechanisms, associate support and training, and the tools partners rely on to process returns. You will translate what you learn in the field into scalable programs, work across internal teams to launch them in Italy, and help shape how the broader EU standards themselves are built, turning local, on-the-ground insight into lasting structural improvement. This is also a founding, build-from-scratch role. You'll be the first ISX Program Manager in Italy and one of the earliest members of the EU field team, reporting directly to the EU ISX Senior Manager. There's no established playbook yet, you'll help create it. We're looking for someone with real ambition, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to focus relentlessly on the initiatives that matter most while the team, tools, and standards are still taking shape. Key job responsibilities Own the in-store returns experience in Italy across ~17,000 partner and carrier locations, ensuring returns are fast, easy, and reliable for customers across all return types. Get into the field and coach. Visit partner locations, observe how returns are handled, and coach partner teams to Amazon's standards for speed, accuracy, and customer experience. Use data to prioritize. You can't be everywhere. Use performance data to identify the locations and partners falling furthest behind and concentrate your effort where it improves the customer experience most. Drive measurable improvement on the metrics that define a great returns experience: how fast customers are served, how reliably returns are processed, customer satisfaction, and site readiness. Deploy network-wide improvements. Lead the rollout of scalable programs that raise the standard across the entire Italian network, including in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and returns-processing tools , using your field insight to prioritize and adapt them for the market. Shape strategy from the field. Turn on-the-ground observations into recommendations that influence how EU-wide returns standards, mechanisms, and programs are designed, ensuring the field perspective is built in from the start. Manage performance to resolution. Follow a structured coaching and follow-up cycle for underperforming sites, and partner with the right internal teams (Business Partnerships for retail partners, the Transportation team for carriers) when issues need to be escalated to a partner's leadership. Build the foundation. As a founding team member, help shape how the EU field team audits, coaches, and reports, adapting proven practices from the North America team to the Italian market and feed your field insights into the monthly ISX reporting that informs strategy. A day in the life You start the week by reviewing performance data for Italy and identifying the partner locations and carriers falling furthest behind on the customer experience. You spend time in the field visiting a risk-weighted set of those sites, watching real customers complete returns, checking that the process is running smoothly, and coaching partner teams on the spot. Back at your desk, you're also driving the Italy rollout of a new signage standard and a store-supplies replenishment mechanism, using what you saw in the field to shape how they're deployed. You log your findings, build improvement plans for the sites that need them, escalate the bigger systemic issues to the right internal team, and close the week by capturing insights for the monthly ISX report and re-planning around wherever the customer experience needs you most. About The Team Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) owns the returns journey end-to-end for Amazon, everything that happens after a customer decides to send something back until delivery at our FC. Our purpose is simple but hard: make returns effortless and reliable for every customer, while running one of the largest, most complex reverse-logistics networks in retail. Within RLS, the In-Store Experience (ISX) team focuses on where returns meet the real world, the thousands of partner and carrier locations customers walk into to drop off an item. We turn a single promise into a consistent reality across every one of them: fast, easy, dependable returns, no matter which door a customer chooses. Working from the field, we close the gap between the best and worst locations, coach partners to a standard customers can count on, and build the mechanisms that lift the whole network at once. Our culture is hands-on, data-driven, and high-ownership. We obsess over the customer, thrive in ambiguity, dive deep into the details on the ground, and think big about how to scale what works — because the best decisions about in-store returns are made by people who've seen them happen firsthand. Enrico Petracco Enrico Petracco PlayMore! is a fast-growing non-profit organization that promotes Sport, Participation and Wellbeing, for All , since 2010. We are looking for an experienced leader to drive the growth and international expansion of our flagship project, RunChallenge. About RunChallenge RunChallenge is an international community that promotes participation and wellbeing through sport, particularly running and walking, bringing together people with and without disabilities, including wheelchair users. Every week, more than 1,100 people with and without disabilities take part in training sessions and social activities organized across 14 European cities . Over the years, RunChallenge has received several awards. Among the most significant: Finalist (Top 3) at the European Commission #BeInclusive EU Sport Awards 2021 ; Charity of the Year at the Milan Marathon 2025 ; Top Fundraiser Non-Profit Organization at the Milan Marathon Awards 2026 ; Best Cheering Point at the Milan Marathon Awards in 2024, 2025 and 2026 . In 2026, SDA Bocconi School of Management published a research study to RunChallenge entitled Scaling Social Inclusion through Sport: The RunChallenge Case , validating the project's development model and highlighting its potential for growth and expansion. We firmly believe this potential is still significant because RunChallenge addresses two of the greatest challenges of our time: tackling loneliness and physical inactivity . Our dream is to transform RunChallenge into the Scout Movement of Sport : a global movement capable of spreading a culture of participation through thousands of local communities united by the same values. If our vision resonates with you and you're excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of RunChallenge, we'd love to hear from you. The Role The Head of RunChallenge will be responsible for leading the evolution of the project, working closely with the CEO of PlayMore! and coordinating the project team, which currently includes: 1 Senior Project Manager 1 Event Manager 1 Junior Project Manager 1 Head Coach 1 Educational Coordinator 8 Sport trainers and Educators Key Responsibilities Following an onboarding period designed to provide a deep understanding of PlayMore!'s culture, the RunChallenge model and the activities already in place, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following areas: Vision and Strategy Define RunChallenge's three-year development strategy in Italy and abroad Strengthen the existing RunChallenge Social Franchising model Define objectives, priorities, KPIs and monitoring tools Lead the three-year operational plan, ensuring alignment between strategic vision and day-to-day execution Network Development Manage and expand the international RunChallenge network, overseeing the team member responsible for partner relations and network expansion Design and implement new strategies to identify and engage potential partners interested in bringing RunChallenge to their local communities Identify new development opportunities, partnerships and ways to scale the project Team Leadership Lead the RunChallenge team, enhancing the skills, responsibilities and motivation of all team members Work collaboratively with the leaders of the organization's other strategic areas: Communication, Fundraising, Administration, Volunteers, Events and Activities Promote a team culture based on trust, accountability, constructive feedback and continuous improvement Ensure quality, consistency and continuity throughout the experience of participants, volunteers, donors and project partners Events, Community and Representation Design and oversee the delivery of all RunChallenge events, including both sporting events and initiatives aimed at strengthening the network (such as the Milano Relay Marathon, the RunChallenge Gathering at Anteo Cinema, the RC> International Meeting, etc.) Represent RunChallenge at public events, institutional occasions and networking opportunities Manage relationships with the project's stakeholders (public institutions, corporate partners, private donors, direct and indirect beneficiaries) Design and coordinate initiatives that strengthen the sense of belonging within the RunChallenge community, beyond sporting activities Project Quality In day-to-day operations, ensure quality, consistency and attention to detail across every aspect of the RunChallenge experience: sporting activities, social gatherings, sporting and community events, and both external and internal communication. Position: Customer Service Manager Brand: Alumo (Ultra-Premium Shirting Fabrics) Location: Italy Reporting & Team: Reports to Commercial Director | Direct Team: 2 Representatives | CONTEXT AND CHALLENGE Chargeurs PCC is the world’s leading provider of textiles and inner component solutions: from luxury fashion to athleisure and everything in between. Interlinings are the soul of any garment, giving structure, shape, and added performance to every piece. With over 350 million meters of interlinings produced annually across 10 production sites, Chargeurs PCC supports 7,000 customers around the world, from iconic fashion houses to technical apparel leaders. Now expanding beyond interlinings, Chargeurs PCC has launched its first outer fabric collection, setting new standards in performance, design, and responsible innovation. Chargeurs PCC is a division of Belgrano (formerly Compagnie Chargeurs Invest), listed on the EXN Paris, with a successful industrial history of over 150 years. We are seeking an energetic, resilient, and forward-thinking Customer Service Manager to lead our front-office operations in Italy for Alumo, the historic Swiss brand globally recognized as the pinnacle of luxury cotton shirting fabrics. The entity is currently undergoing an extensive restructuring program aimed at modernizing workflows, increasing operational agility, and harmonizing customer-facing activities. The primary mission will be twofold: to ensure impeccable day-to-day service continuity for our global clientele while spearheading the total redesign and optimization of operational processes. The role requires navigating legacy systems for an initial transition period of a few months while actively championing and preparing the organization for the implementation of a modern, future-proof ERP system. | RESPONSIBILITIES Process Redesign & Optimization: Re-engineer end-to-end customer care and order management workflows. Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs), eliminate operational bottlenecks, define service KPIs, and build a lean, scalable order fulfillment experience matching luxury standards. ERP Modernization & Change Management: Serve as the key operational champion for the upcoming ERP rollout. Lead requirement definition, workflow testing, data integrity, and team onboarding, while ensuring flawless execution on the legacy ERP during the initial interim months. Team Leadership & Organization: Manage, coach, and organize the daily work of a 2-person customer service team. Allocate accounts, structure workloads, foster high autonomy, and cultivate a collaborative culture rooted in transparency, mutual support, and operational rigor. Operational Customer Care: Oversee the complete lifecycle of customer orders—from initial inquiry, custom swatch requests, and price quotations to order entry, production tracking, shipping coordination, and billing. Step in directly to manage complex or VIP client inquiries. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the vital liaison between customer service, sales leadership, warehouse logistics, and planning to guarantee frictionless communication, rapid issue resolution, and accurate delivery timelines. | PROFILE REQUIREMENTS Experience: Solid background (minimum 4–6 years) in customer service or sales operations, including at least 2–3 years in a managerial or team-lead role. Prior background in luxury B2B sectors, high-end menswear, bespoke tailoring, premium textiles, or complex manufacturing environments is strongly preferred. Process & Systems Savvy: Demonstrated track record of process redesign, workflow structuring, or participating directly in ERP migration/modernization projects. Comfort and pragmatism in navigating legacy systems while preparing new digital solutions. Languages: Full professional fluency in both English and Italian (written and spoken) is strictly required. A good working knowledge or fluency in French is considered a distinct competitive advantage. Resilience & Velocity: Thrives in evolving environments undergoing structural change; capable of delivering swift, high-quality solutions under pressure. Organization & Autonomy: Super organized with rigorous attention to detail, proactive self-starter mindset, and the ability to take full ownership of operational challenges. Leadership & Transparency: True team player with empathetic yet clear communication, fostering an open and transparent dialogue across all internal and external touchpoints. | WHY JOIN US? Join an Undisputed Luxury Leader: The opportunity to play a transformative operational role within one of the most prestigious and historic names in the global luxury textile industry. Competitive Compensation: Attractive compensation package comprising a structured base salary and a rewarding incentive plan tied to organizational milestones and operational performance. Company Equipment & Tools: Complete suite of professional IT tools and resources (laptop, smartphone, ergonomic office setup). Executive Exposure: Direct visibility and collaboration with executive management, offering substantial influence over the entity's organizational evolution.
